authority_statement: Informational report only; the deterministic LFighter pipeline retains all security decision authority.
executive_summary: In the evaluated targeted label-flip condition, the plain DDoS-to-Benign rate exceeded the paired clean rate; the defended rate was lower than the plain rate. Attribution distance moved toward the paired preattack clean reference after reconstruction.

facts.statement: The plain attack mean DDoS-to-Benign prediction rate was 0.404618, versus 0.056499 in the paired clean branch.
The defended mean DDoS-to-Benign prediction rate was 0.097069, an absolute reduction of 0.307549 from the plain attack branch.
Mean and minimum malicious recall were 1.000000; maximum benign false-positive rate was 0.100000.
Normalized attribution distance decreased from 0.836269 to 0.507945, with recovery fraction 0.392606.

interpretations.statement: Observed prediction behavior is consistent with targeted suppression of DDoS predictions toward the Benign class, but does not establish malicious intent.
Reconstruction moved the attribution profile toward its paired preattack clean reference; this is not evidence of oracle clean restoration.

refusals: Refuse to assert verified malicious intent; the supplied evidence does not establish it.
Refuse to claim exact oracle clean recovery; the oracle clean attribution state was unavailable.
No client flag, threshold, trust-weight, reconstruction, or aggregation decision is made in this report.
uncertainties: The clean attribution comparator is a paired round 4 preattack reference, not an oracle clean state.
Rejected and oracle-clean attribution states were unavailable and were not substituted.
Per-client detector scores and numeric detector thresholds were not materialized.
Evidence is limited to development and validation; reserved test arrays remained closed.
